title: Enhancing Attention with Higher-Order Attention
abstract: arXiv:2611.27764v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Current decoder large language models rely on a combination of attention, feed forward and residual layers. The attention used is autoregressive (AR) though this is not strictly correct, as we note. That motivates the introduction of other attention methods that, while also not strictly AR, do enhance the AR character. One is based on a decomposition of mutual information (MI) into a set of Conditional MIs (CMIs) that correlate key tokens with pairs of query tokens. A second, higher-order attention, introduces correlations between contiguous key and query tokens. A third introduces correlations between a set of key and query tokens and uses a Generalized Maximum Entropy Principle to obtain an attention expression spanning a sequence of tokens. translated_title: 用高阶注意力增强注意力机制
translated_abstract: 当前的解码器式大语言模型依赖于注意力层、前馈层和残差层的组合。目前所使用的注意力是自回归（AR）的，尽管我们注意到这并不严格成立。这促使我们引入其他注意力方法，这些方法虽然同样不严格自回归，但确实能增强自回归特性。第一种方法基于将互信息（MI）分解为一组条件互信息（CMI），使关键token与查询token对相关联。第二种是高阶注意力，引入相邻的关键token与查询token之间的关联。第三种引入一组关键token与查询token之间的关联，并使用广义最大熵原理得到一个跨越token序列的注意力表达式。所有这些方法都可以增强推理/生成中所使用的自回归概率的信息含量。论文还展示了这些方法在对比解码中的应用以及系统的分析（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出三种新型注意力机制（条件互信息分解、高阶注意力、基于广义最大熵原理的集合关联注意力），用以增强自回归概率的信息含量，从而提升大语言模型推理与生成的能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes three novel attention mechanisms—conditional mutual information decomposition, higher-order attention, and set-based correlations via the Generalized Maximum Entropy Principle—to enrich the information content of autoregressive probabilities and enhance inference and generation in decoder LLMs.
